arxiv-1408-2871.title: Affinity Prediction in Online Social Networks
arxiv-1408-2871.creator: Matias Estrada 1 2 and Marcelo Mendoza 2
arxiv-1408-2871.description: Abstract Link prediction is the problem of inferring whether potential edges between pairs of vertices in a graph will be present or absent in the near future. To perform this task it is usual to use information provided by a number of available and observed vertices/edges. Then, a number of edge scoring methods based on this information can be created.

arxiv-1812-01901.title: Gravitational wave and collider probes of a triplet Higgs sector with a low cutoff
arxiv-1812-01901.creator: Mikael Chala a , Maria Ramos b and Michael Spannowsky a a Institute of Particle Physics Phenomenology, Physics Department, Durham University, Durham DH1 3LE, UK b Laboratório de Instrumentação e Física Experimental de Partículas, Departamento de Física da Universidade do Minho, Campus de Gualtar, 47
arxiv-1812-01901.description: A 2018 arXiv research paper by Mikael Chala a , Maria Ramos b and Michael Spannowsky a a Institute of Particle Physics Phenomenology, Physics Department, Durham University, Durham DH1 3LE, UK b Laboratório de Instrumentação e Física Experimental de Partículas, Departamento de Física da Universidade do Minho, Campus de Gualtar, 47. We study the scalar triplet extension of the standard model with a low cutoff, preventing large corrections to the quadratic masses that would otherwise worsen the hierarchy problem.

arxiv-2212-14269.title: Spectral analysis of some non-normal operators arising in Reggeon field theory
arxiv-2212-14269.creator: Abdelkader INTISSAR
arxiv-2212-14269.description: Abstract In this work, we present a complete spectral study of a family of non-normal operators arising in Reggeon field theory. This family of operators is an original example who permit us to discover the recent theory of physical requirement of space-time reflection symmetry (PT symmetry) without losing any of the essential physical features of quantum mechanics [Bender] .

arxiv-2403-16083.title: Quantifying Arbitrage in Automated Market Makers: An Empirical Study of Ethereum ZK Rollups
arxiv-2403-16083.creator: Krzysztof Gogol, Johnnatan Messias, Deborah Miori, Claudio Tessone, Benjamin Livshits
arxiv-2403-16083.description: Abstract Arbitrage opportunities arise from the simultaneous buying and selling of the same asset in different markets to profit from price differences. This research systematically explores arbitrage possibilities between Automated Market Makers (AMMs) on Ethereum zk-rollups and Centralized Exchanges (CEXs).

arxiv-2403-19918.title: CtRL-Sim: Reactive and Controllable Driving Agents with Offline Reinforcement Learning
arxiv-2403-19918.creator: Luke Rowe, Roger Girgis, Anthony Gosselin, Bruno Carrez, Florian Golemo, Felix Heide, Liam Paull, Christopher Pal
arxiv-2403-19918.description: A 2024 arXiv research paper by Luke Rowe, Roger Girgis, Anthony Gosselin, Bruno Carrez, Florian Golemo, Felix Heide, Liam Paull, Christopher Pal. Evaluating autonomous vehicle stacks (AVs) in simulation typically involves replaying driving logs from real-world recorded traffic. However, agents replayed from offline data are not reactive and hard to intuitively control. Existing approaches address these challenges by proposing methods that rely on heuristics or generative models of real-world data but these approaches either lack realism or necessitate costly iterative sampling procedures to control the generated behaviours.

arxiv-2405-14829.title: Analog Counterdiabatic Quantum Computing
arxiv-2405-14829.creator: Qi Zhang ∗, Narendra N. Hegade †, Alejandro Gomez Cadavid, Lucas Lassablière, Jan Trautmann, Sébastien Perseguers, Enrique Solano ‡, Loïc Henriet, Eric Michon §
arxiv-2405-14829.description: Abstract We propose analog counterdiabatic quantum computing (ACQC) to tackle combinatorial optimization problems on neutral-atom quantum processors. While these devices allow for the use of hundreds of qubits, adiabatic quantum computing struggles with non-adiabatic errors, which are inevitable due to the hardware’s restricted coherence time.

arxiv-2408-00304.title: Constraint Energy Minimizing Generalized Multiscale Finite Element Method for Convection Diffusion Equations with Inhomogeneous Boundary Conditions
arxiv-2408-00304.creator: Po Chai WONG, Eric T. CHUNG, Changqing YE, Lina ZHAO
arxiv-2408-00304.description: Abstract \emph{Keywords} constraint energy minimization, multiscale finite element methods, inhomogeneous boundary value problem, convection-diffusion equation 1 Introduction Convection diffusion equation is involved in many physical applications of partial differential equations. Computational difficulty may arise in two-fold: (1) coefficients in high contrast and multiple scales and (2) demanding discretization for a high Péclet number.

arxiv-2408-07590.title: Creating Data Art: Authentic Learning and Visualisation Exhibition
arxiv-2408-07590.creator: Jonathan C. Roberts Bangor University, UK
arxiv-2408-07590.description: Abstract We present an authentic learning task designed for computing students, centred on the creation of data-art visualisations from chosen datasets for a public exhibition. This exhibition was showcased in the cinema foyer for two weeks in June, providing a real-world platform for students to display their work.

arxiv-2409-10627.title: A machine learning framework to generate star cluster realisations
arxiv-2409-10627.creator: George P. Prodan ,, Mario Pasquato, Giuliano Iorio, Alessandro Ballone, Stefano Torniamenti, Ugo Niccolò Di Carlo, Michela Mapelli
arxiv-2409-10627.description: Abstract Context. Computational astronomy has reached the stage where running a gravitational N N -body simulation of a stellar system, such as a Milky Way star cluster, is computationally feasible, but a major limiting factor that remains is the ability to set up physically realistic initial conditions. Aims.

arxiv-2503-15410.title: Loophole-free argument for physicality of electromagnetic potential from causal structure of flux quantization
arxiv-2503-15410.creator: Konrad Schlichtholz, Marcin Markiewicz
arxiv-2503-15410.description: Abstract Recent work by Vaidman [Phys. Rev. A 86, 040101 (2012)] showed that Aharonov-Bohm effect can be explained in terms of local fields, thus effectively restating an old problem of physicality of potentials. In this work, we propose an argument demonstrating the physicality of electromagnetic potential (upon the assumption of locality) based on the causal structure in flux quantization setup.

arxiv-2504-15578.title: Real-Time Optimal Design of Experiment for Parameter Identification of Li-Ion Cell Electrochemical Model
arxiv-2504-15578.creator: Ian Mikesell, Samuel Filgueira da Silva, Mehmet Fatih Ozkan, Faissal El Idrissi, Prashanth Ramesh, Marcello Canova
arxiv-2504-15578.description: Abstract Accurately identifying the parameters of electrochemical models of li-ion battery (LiB) cells is a critical task for enhancing the fidelity and predictive ability. Traditional parameter identification methods often require extensive data collection experiments and lack adaptability in dynamic environments.

arxiv-2505-20070.title: DRAGyS - A comprehensive tool to extract scattering phase functions in protoplanetary disks
arxiv-2505-20070.creator: M. Roumesy, F. Ménard, R. Tazaki, G. Duchêne, L. Martinien, R. Zerna
arxiv-2505-20070.description: Abstract Context. The early stages of planet formation, involving dust grain growth and planetesimals formation, remain shrouded in mystery. The analysis of the Scattering Phase Function (SPF) measured in disks surrounding young stars holds great potential for revealing crucial information about dust grain properties.

arxiv-2507-17434.title: From shallow to full wrapping: geometry and deformability dictate lipid vesicle internalization
arxiv-2507-17434.creator: Stijn van der Ham, Alexander Brown, Halim Kusumaatmaja, Hanumantha Rao Vutukuri
arxiv-2507-17434.description: A 2025 arXiv research paper by Stijn van der Ham, Alexander Brown, Halim Kusumaatmaja, Hanumantha Rao Vutukuri. The deformability of vesicles critically influences their engulfment by lipid membranes, a process central to endocytosis, viral entry, drug delivery, and intercellular transport. While theoretical models have long predicted this influence, direct experimental validation has remained elusive. Here, we combine experiments with continuum simulations to quantify how vesicle deformability affects the engulfment of small giant unilamellar vesicles (GUVs) by larger GUVs under depletion-induced adhesion.

arxiv-2510-07862.title: On the Optimality of Tracking Fisher Information in Adaptive Testing with Stochastic Binary Responses
arxiv-2510-07862.creator: Sanghwa Kim, Dohyun Ahn, Seungki Min
arxiv-2510-07862.description: Abstract We study the problem of estimating a continuous ability parameter from sequential binary responses by actively asking questions with varying difficulties, a setting that arises naturally in adaptive testing and online preference learning. Our goal is to certify that the estimate lies within a desired margin of error, using as few queries as possible.

pmc-11362032.title: Charcot neuro-osteoarthropathy: a review of key concepts and an evidence-based surgical management algorithm
pmc-11362032.creator: Miltiadis Argyropoulos, William Wynell-Mayow, Oscar Johnson, Radwane Faroug, Karanjeev Singh Johal, Rupinderbir Singh Deol, Atef Hakmi, Simon Mordecai
pmc-11362032.description: Charcot neuro-osteoarthropathy (CNO), mainly as a result of diabetic neuropathy, is a complex problem which carries significant morbidity, and is an increasing burden on healthcare as demographics change globally. A multi-disciplinary team (MDT) is necessary to treat the multiple facets of this disease.

pmc-11512576.title: High Prevalence of Work-Related Musculoskeletal Disorders Among Dentists: A Cross-Sectional Study From Kerala, India
pmc-11512576.creator: PM Gopika, Silpa T Sasi, Jeby J Olickal, Kavumpurathu R Thankappan
pmc-11512576.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2024). Background: Literature on the prevalence of musculoskeletal disorders (MSD), work ability, and associated factors among dentists is limited. Therefore, this study aimed to determine the prevalence of MSD, work ability, and associated factors among dentists in Kerala, India.Methods: This cross-sectional study was conducted among 290 dentists (median age: 34 years, 47% male), selected from a list of dentists in a district of Kerala.

pmc-11635220.title: Treating deep sternal wound infection with pectoralis major flap transposition: a systemic factor analysis of efficacy and safety
pmc-11635220.creator: Qiuming Hu, Kaisheng Wu, Zhang Chen, Adnan Abibe Goia, Connor J Maloney, James D Maloney, Haibo Zhang
pmc-11635220.description: BackgroundDeep sternal wound infection (DSWI) is a life-threatening postoperative complication of cardiac surgery. Currently, there are many therapies used to treat patients with DSWI. However, none of these therapies have been shown to be the optimal choice for patients with DSWI. Additionally, these methods may require additional facilities which limit their widespread use.

pmc-11678858.title: ZmSPL12 Enhances Root Penetration and Elongation in Maize Under Compacted Soil Conditions by Responding to Ethylene Signaling
pmc-11678858.creator: Hua Xu, Zhigang Zheng, Lei Ma, Qingyun Zhang, Lian Jin, Ke Zhang, Junjie Zou, Hada Wuriyanghan, Miaoyun Xu
pmc-11678858.description: Soil compaction poses a significant challenge in modern agriculture, as it constrains root development and hinders crop growth. The increasing evidence indicated that various phytohormones collaborate in distinct root zones to regulate root growth in compacted soils. However, the study of root development in maize under such conditions has been relatively limited.

pmc-12655607.title: Raw Milk as a Source of Campylobacter Infection: Isolation and Molecular Identification of Campylobacter coli and Campylobacter jejuni in Ecuador
pmc-12655607.creator: Andrea Padilla-Cerda, Anthony Loor-Giler, Byron Puga-Torres, Silvana Santander-Parra, Luis Núñez
pmc-12655607.description: The consumption of raw milk has been demonstrated to carry a potential risk of transmission of Campylobacter spp., with Campylobacter jejuni (C. jejuni) and Campylobacter coli (C. coli) being the major causes for foodborne gastroenteritis cases. The present study assessed the prevalence and species distribution of Campylobacter spp.

pmc-13093585.title: Development of Glioblastoma Multiforme in Patients With Human Papillomavirus‐Positive Oropharyngeal Squamous Cell Carcinoma: A Case Series
pmc-13093585.creator: Jessica T Lovett, Michael Wotman, Ryan Denu, Aishwarya Mandava, Hardik Shah, Robert Sebra, William Westra, Marshall Posner
pmc-13093585.description: BackgroundHuman papillomavirus‐positive oropharyngeal squamous cell carcinoma (HPV+ OPC) patients typically exhibit reduced rates of second primary malignancies (SPMs) compared to HPV‐negative head and neck cancer patients. While HPV+ OPC patients may be predisposed to SPMs in HPV‐associated anatomical sites, the metachronous presentation of an HPV+ OPC and subsequent glioblastoma multiforme (GBM) has not been previously documented.

pmc-13122652.title: Investigation of the improvement effect of Dajianzhong decoction on rats with post-operative ileus based on serum metabolomics and spectrum-effect relationship
pmc-13122652.creator: Zhufeng Cong, Tianren Xu, Xuan Kang, Zheng Zhong, Honglei Zhou, Yanan Li
pmc-13122652.description: IntroductionPostoperative ileus (POI) is a common complication following abdominal surgery, with limited preventive and therapeutic strategies. Dajianzhong Decoction (DJZD), a classic formula in traditional Chinese medicine, has demonstrated clinical potential in alleviating POI, yet its underlying composition and molecular mechanisms remain to be systematically elucidated.

pmc-13141686.title: ZnO/AC recovered from PET bottles via pyrolysis for the hybrid treatment (adsorption/photocatalysis) of BB41 dye in aqueous media
pmc-13141686.creator: Nadjib Dahdouh, Haroun Hafsa, Badreddine Djemmali, Amina Ouarghi, Imane Kezrane, Toufik Chaabane, Venkataraman Sivasankar, Mohammed Kebir
pmc-13141686.description: Plastic waste continues to increase on land and poses a critical danger to human life, which is why our contribution addresses this issue. Waste PET bottles were collected and subjected to pyrolysis to produce activated carbon, which was then doped with ZnO to form a ZnO/AC(PET) heterostructured composite.

pmc-13159337.title: Adult-onset refractory retroperitoneal neuroblastoma with diagnostic and therapeutic challenges: a case report and review of literature
pmc-13159337.creator: Nitesh Kumar Karna, Gopal Pokhrel, Akshyata Osti, Nitesh Neupane, Popular Pokhrel, Karun Bhattarai, Rajan Ray, Shreejan Khanal, Rajeev Sharma, Soniya Dulal
pmc-13159337.description: BackgroundNeuroblastoma is a rare, aggressive childhood malignancy originating from neural crest progenitor cells of the sympathetic nervous system. While primarily a pediatric tumor, adult-onset neuroblastoma poses significant diagnostic and therapeutic challenges owing to its rarity, absence of standardized treatment protocols, and poor response to therapy.

pmc-13185291.title: Translation, cultural adaptation, and psychometric validation of the Persian caregiver empowerment scale for stroke survivors for use in Iran
pmc-13185291.creator: Kosar Pourhasan, Mohammad Fasih, Parvaneh Vasli
pmc-13185291.description: BackgroundEmpowering family caregivers (FCGs) of stroke survivors can improve the quality of care they provide and reduce their stress levels. This study focused on translating, culturally adapting and testing the Persian version of Caregiver Empowerment Scale (CES) for FCGs of stroke survivors.MethodsThis methodological investigation was conducted in two large hospitals in Tehran, Iran, during the 2024–25 academic year.

pmc-13462299.title: Low Prevalence of Human T‐Cell Lymphotropic Virus Type 1 (HTLV‐1) in a Hospital Triage Population in Tehran During 2024–2025
pmc-13462299.creator: Arash Letafati, Shima Sadeghipour Marvi, Negar Asghari Hosori, Ghazale Molaverdi, Alireza Esfandiari, Nima Afshar Moghadam, Shabnam Siavoshi, Mehdi Norouzi, Sayed‐Hamidreza Mozhgani
pmc-13462299.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2026). Background and AimsHuman T‐cell lymphotropic virus type 1 (HTLV‐1) is a retrovirus that is associated to adult T‐cell leukemia/lymphoma (ATLL) and HTLV‐1–associated myelopathy/tropical spastic paraparesis (HAM/TSP) as two major diseases of the virus.

pmc-13567606.title: Biochar-Driven Activity Enhancement of Co3O4 Catalyst for 4-Nitrophenol Reduction: RSM-CCD Optimization, Kinetic Insights, and Recyclability
pmc-13567606.creator: Layla El Moussaoui, Majda Ben Ali, Abdellah Benzaouak, Oumaima Sadik, Mohammed Dahhou, Abdelekbir Bellaouchou, Adnane El Hamidi, Abdelouahed Lokmane
pmc-13567606.description: To decrease the environmental and health consequences associated with pollution, several cobalt oxides-decorated biochar substrates have been developed for effective catalytic reduction of 4-NP. The porous biochar was produced by pyrolysis of sewage sludge and acid demineralization, and subsequently, Co3O4 was loaded with varying amounts to synthesize Co3O4/biochar nanocomposites.
